name: cytochrome P450 family 4 subfamily A member 11

function.text: CYP4A11 is the approved symbol for cytochrome P450 family 4 subfamily A member 11. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in alkane 1-monooxygenase activity; arachidonate epoxygenase activity; arachidonate metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: CYP4A11 encodes cytochrome P450 family 4 subfamily A member 11. Its functions include alkane 1-monooxygenase activity and arachidonate epoxygenase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYP4A11 have been reported in breast carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
